No automatic positive admission until a per-relation/per-source evaluation supports a one-sided 95% lower confidence bound of at least 95% precision. 59 independent all-correct cases reach approximately 0.9505; correlated disclosures require an adjusted design, not this shortcut.

At least 95% of accessible material filing/corporate-action changes are observed and routed within 48 hours; visible stale/unavailable status is mandatory when source cadence or rights prevent refresh. Validity and retrieval freshness remain separate.
Material confirmed errors are withheld or corrected by the next ordinary publication; the original view remains reproducible and correction latency is measured.
At least 90% success on predefined investor explanation tasks, measured separately for EN/ZH and supported desktop/mobile views; exact ID/status/date parity on every release journey.
No prediction/allocation promotion from descriptive acceptance. The existing evaluator must separately judge PIT baselines, leakage, costs, robustness, calibration and the specific intended use.
